_comment: Mutation testing scoped to the functional cores. Line coverage says a line ran; a surviving mutant says nothing asserted its behaviour. Only *.core.ts is worth mutating — it is pure, so every mutant is deterministic and fast.
_mutateComment: theme.core.ts is excluded because scripts/theme-emit.core.test.ts reads its source text for an anchor, and instrumented source no longer has it.
_disableTypeChecksComment: The default pattern also stamps // @ts-nocheck into committed HTML such as examples/extensions/hello/index.html, which a drift test compares byte for byte. Only touch the files we mutate.
_inPlaceComment: Bun workspaces keep deps like effect and @pid/shared in each app's own node_modules. A sandbox copy only links the root one, so every test failed to import. Mutate in place instead.
